readiness.title: Release readiness
readiness.authority: Readiness is an assessment. Test approval, risk acceptance and release authorization are separate decisions.

readiness.invalidated: This candidate is invalidated. Freeze a new candidate before testing again.
readiness.reason.INITIAL_DEPLOYMENT_UNVE: Deployment was not verified before testing
readiness.reason.RUN_BEFORE_FREEZE: Run started before criteria were frozen
